summary: Variables are flattened per host before a play, overwriting by default. Precedence is all < parent group < child group < host; same-level groups merge alphabetically, and ansible_group_priority (default 1) changes that order.
questions: What is the precedence order for inventory variables?
Which group wins when two sibling groups set the same variable?
How do I make one group's variables take priority?

answer_card.title: How inventory variables are merged
answer_card.answer_md:
Lowest to highest:
1. `all` group
2. parent group
3. child group
4. host

Groups at the same level merge **alphabetically**, so `b_group` overrides `a_group`. Set `ansible_group_priority` (default `1`) to change that: higher numbers merge later and win.
